raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays demonstrate progressive, diffuse bilateral fluffy infiltrates and nodular opacities rather than a solitary nodule or localized consolidation. This radiographic pattern is characteristic of the diffuse pneumonic type of bronchioloalveolar carcinoma (now invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma), which indicates aggressive multinodular disease with a poor prognosis.
